methods.name: RD bandwidth selection: rdrobust::rdbwselect, all ten methods (sharp)
methods.reference: rdrobust::rdbwselect(y, x, c, p, q, kernel, vce, nnmatch, scaleregul, all = TRUE) 4.0.0; rdrobust::rdrobust with selected bandwidths
quantities: h and b, left and right, for mserd, msetwo, msesum, msecomb1, msecomb2, cerrd, certwo, cersum, cercomb1, cercomb2
three kernels; p = 0, 1, 2; q = 3; nn (nnmatch 1, 3) and HC0-HC3; scaleregul 0 and 1
rdrobust estimate, SEs, CI, p and N_h/N_b at selected bandwidths (mserd, cerrd, msetwo, rho = 1, scaleregul 0, hc1, mass points, a given b)
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 1000: bandwidths and coefficients 1e-8, SE/statistics/CI 1e-6 relative, p-values 1e-6 relative + 1e-12 absolute, counts exact; R transcription agreement <= 2.0e-13

deviations.quantity: b given while h is selected
deviations.note: p2a uses the given b; rdrobust ignores b when h is not given. Pinned to rdrobust(h = selected h, b = 0.5)

methods.name: RD bandwidth selection and estimation, fuzzy: rdbwselect(fuzzy = ), rdrobust(fuzzy = )
methods.reference: rdrobust::rdbwselect(y, x, c, fuzzy, all = TRUE) 4.0.0; rdrobust::rdrobust(fuzzy = ) with selected bandwidths
quantities: ten methods with nn and hc1
Wald estimate, bias-corrected estimate, SEs, CI, p, N_h and first stage at selected bandwidths (mserd, cerrd)
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 1000: bandwidths and coefficients 1e-8, SE/statistics/CI 1e-6 relative, p-values 1e-6 relative + 1e-12 absolute, counts exact; R transcription agreement <= 2.0e-13

methods.name: Multi-cutoff RD with per-cutoff rdbwselect bandwidths; p2a pooling
methods.reference: rdrobust::rdrobust per cutoff with rdbwselect bandwidths (as rdmulti::rdmc's cutoff-specific estimates) 4.0.0; p2a's pooling and heterogeneity test written out in R
quantities: per-cutoff effect, robust SE, CI (95%, 90%), p, h, b, N_h (rdrobust as in rdmc)
pooled effect, SE, CI, p and weights (sample-size, inverse-variance, equal)
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 1000: bandwidths and coefficients 1e-8, SE/statistics/CI 1e-6 relative, p-values 1e-6 relative + 1e-12 absolute, counts exact; R transcription agreement <= 2.0e-13

deviations.note: p2a pools the cutoff estimates by a weighted average with independent SEs, pinned to that formula written out in R (causal_rdbw.R). rdmulti::rdmc's pooled estimate (rdrobust on the normalised score x - c) is a different estimator; rdmulti is not installed
